title: Acupuncture and Acupressure for Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in Children Undergoing Outpatient Middle Ear Surgery
brief_summary: The specific aim of this study is to determine the incidence of post-operative nausea and vomiting (PONV) in the pediatric population undergoing outpatient middle ear surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy ASA 1 and 2 Patients
* Age 2 to 18 years old
* Undergoing Outpatient Middle ear surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* ASA 3 and above
* Patients with underlying pro-emetogenic disease
* Patients currently taking antiemetic agents
* pregnant women
* Cognitively impaired adults
* prisoners
* History of bleeding disorder
* Age less than 2 or greater than 18
